Definition: to pinch, i.e. (partially) to bite the lips, blink the eyes (as a gesture of malice), or (fully) to squeeze off (a piece of clay in order to mould a vessel from it)
BiblicalUsage: To pinch or bite is the word for the gesture of the schemer: Elihu says he also is formed out of the clay, the worthless man winketh with his eyes, and he that winketh with the eye causeth sorrow.
TheologicalSignificance: I read the wink as the smallest gesture of deceit, and Proverbs notices it because God does.
